svg.title: WP-S-05 Figure 1-2: interfaces and their signals
svg.desc: Interfaces: IF-01 Remote operations station to Safety monitor controller (I-08): SIG-01 Remote driving command SIGNED timeout 143 ms, SIG-02 Release after a minimal risk condition SIGNED; IF-02 Autoware computer to Safety monitor controller (I-03): SIG-03 Control command E2E timeout 143 ms, SIG-04 Lamp command E2E, SIG-05 Autoware heartbeat and state E2E timeout 143 ms, SIG-06 Monitor status to Autoware E2E; IF-03 Safety LiDAR to Safety channel processor (I-13): SIG-07 LiDAR point cloud E2E timeout 200 ms; IF-04 Safety radar to Safety channel processor (I-13): SIG-08 Radar detections E2E timeout 200 ms; IF-05 Safety channel processor to Safety monitor controller (I-13): SIG-09 Obstacle and free-space report E2E timeout 179 ms, SIG-10 Safety channel status E2E timeout 179 ms; IF-06 Safety monitor controller to Drive-by-wire (I-04): SIG-11 Bounded motion command E2E timeout 179 ms, SIG-12 Propulsion cut and brake switch E2E timeout 179 ms, SIG-13 Drive-by-wire status E2E timeout 179 ms; IF-07 Vehicle state sensing to Safety monitor controller (I-05): SIG-14 Longitudinal vehicle state E2E timeout 179 ms, SIG-15 Steering and gear state E2E timeout 179 ms, SIG-16 Collision detected E2E; IF-08 Safety monitor controller to Park brake (I-04): SIG-17 Park brake command E2E, SIG-18 Park brake state E2E; IF-09 Door system to Safety monitor controller (I-05): SIG-19 Door state E2E.
svg.text: What crosses each interface, and how fast
WP-S-05 §1, Figure 1-2: each interface of the WP-S-03 architecture, its signals with their protection, the ASIL of the requirements they serve at each
end, their receive timeout from WP-S-04 and the longest period that keeps 3 frames in it. Nothing is measured or selected yet.
